content.text:
The campaign ran Jan 6–8 (Dhaka time) and has now ended on schedule. It spent $649.62 of the $650.00 budget.

## Recap

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost per click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "Close the laptop…" (…580) | $203.12 | 362,808 | 314 | $0.65 |
| "Nine-minute guided… iPhone (iOS) only…" (…546) | $252.07 | 396,990 | 393 | $0.64 |
| "Give your New Year resolution…" (…251) | $194.43 | 377,088 | 301 | $0.65 |
| **Total** | **$649.62** | **1,136,886** | **1,008** | **$0.64** |

**What the reporting shows:** Spend, impressions and link clicks only. **It does not show trial starts.** Your site has no X pixel, so X can't see trial starts, and I couldn't optimize for them. The 1,008 link clicks are clicks to https://jovunarapilates.app/start, not trials. To count trial starts from this campaign, check your app or landing-page analytics for Jan 6–8, for example by X referral traffic.

**How I set it up:**
- One campaign with one ad group, set to get as many link clicks as possible with automatic bidding. That was the closest goal to trial starts I could use without a pixel.
- All three approved posts ran unchanged. No new copy was written.
- Targeting: iPhone (iOS) users in every country except China, to match the offer. The trial deadline (Jan 10) is after the campaign ended, so the offer stayed accurate the whole time.
- I limited it to English-speaking users because all three approved posts are in English. The translated versions you mentioned aren't on this account, so people outside English got no ads. That cut your global reach.

**Changes during the campaign:** Cost per click stayed within about a cent across the three posts the whole time. There was no clear winner to move budget to, so I paused nothing. On the last day I raised the daily budget slightly (from $216.66 to $223.80) so the remaining budget would be used before the end. The $650 total cap stayed in place.

**Next time:**
- Install X's pixel on the trial-start step so X can optimize for trials directly.
- Add your translated posts to this account so other markets can be reached in their own language.
